verdict.rationale: CrewAI's docs include an API reference for the deployed-crew REST endpoints (POST /kickoff, GET /status/{kickoff_id}, POST /resume) and static code examples. Nothing in the evidence shows the reference is interactive or that examples can be run in-browser, and probes for an OpenAPI spec at common paths all returned 404. Missing for 10: evidence of an interactive try-it/playground API explorer, runnable examples within the reference, a published OpenAPI spec, and hands-on corroboration.
